rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name + zip and found the correct order and items. It presented valid replacement options and chose available variants consistent with the user’s preferences. However, it executed the exchange for both items without first explicitly confirming the exact changes with the user, violating the requirement to obtain explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. Later, when the user asked to proceed only with the desk lamp exchange, the agent asserted the exchange could not be changed or canceled without tool-based support or offering a handoff, which is an unsupported claim. These issues—performing writes without confirmation and providing unsupported final information—fail the pass criteria.
